chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim dari ayahnya, dan Muhammad ibn Ismail dari Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, semuanya dari Ibn Abi Umayr, dari Hisham ibn al-Hakam, yang berkata:
Aku melihat Musa (alamah) memberikan ucapan duka cita sebelum dan setelah penguburan.
ai.seo_question: Kapan belasungkawa harus diberikan menurut contoh Musa (AS)?
ai.summary: Hadith, transmitted through the reliable chain of Ibn Abi Umayr and Hisham ibn al-Hakam, highlights the timeless etiquette of *ta'ziyah* (condolences) by citing the practice of Prophet Musa (peace be upon him). It establishes that offering comfort to the bereaved is a recommended act of piety that remains valid both prior to and following the burial, reinforcing its status as a continuous social obligation in Shia jurisprudence.
